## How to Test

<!--Every PR marked ready for review must include testing evidence. A bare "Not tested" or "N/A" answer is not sufficient. For each piece of evidence make clear if the test was executed by the agent or by a human
-->

### What was tested on the robot

- [ ] Subsystem powered and wired correctly
- [ ] OpMode runs without errors on driver station
- [ ] Telemetry shows expected values
- [ ] Motors/servos respond as expected
- [ ] Autonomous path completes (if applicable)
- [ ] Teleop controls mapped correctly

### How it was tested on the robot

- [ ] Driver station + robot on bench
- [ ] Driver station + robot on field
- [ ] Both
